Currently the Madrasah uses three classes in the evening for Madrasah. The Madrasah currently pay?s rent. But the issue has arisen about rent for the Madrasah when it first opened in 2004. Before the Madrasah opened, eminent scholars gave Mushwerah that the building was not used in the evenings and it would be suitable for evening Madrasah, through this it was then decided by the Chairman that the building can be used without any rent being paid, this was due to the Madrasah being new and to get the Madrasah running, at this time none of the Governors of the school were active in the daily issues of the school. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Waqf, Mosque, Madrasa Question ID: 21052 Country: India Title: Is the mimber (pulpit) is must in a mosque or not? Question: Is the mimber (pulpit) is must in a mosque or not? Answer ID: 21052 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 583/383/L=1431) It is mustahab and Sunnah to install pulpit in a mosque: قال العينى فى عمدة القارى فى باب الخطبة على المنبر: و فيه استحباب اتخاد المنبر لكونه أبلغ فى مشاهدة الخطيب والسماع منه (عمدة القارى: 6/216) و فى الطحطاوى على مراقى الفلاح : و ذكر البدرالعينى فى شرح البخارى أن من السنة اتخاذ المنبر عن يمين المحراب (طحطاوى على مراقى الفلاح: 278) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
